purpose: Document first-party registry/map discovery, viewer/service evidence, bounded anonymous request outcomes, and safety limits.
assessment: Official JUPEM sources evidence JUPEM Pahang and the Eastern Pahang District Survey Office in Kuantan as local cadastral custody. Current MyLot configuration exposes Pahang parcel table names and EPSG:3379, but anonymous data requests returned 401 and no complete safe polygon response was obtained.
registryAssessment: JUPEM is the national survey and mapping agency; its official Pahang information identifies the Kuantan headquarters and Eastern Pahang district survey office. This is local cadastral custody evidence, not open citywide parcel geometry.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official JUPEM page identifies JUPEM Pahang in Kuantan and the Eastern Pahang District Survey Office; it describes cadastral survey functions.
Official JUPEM profile lists Pejabat Ukur Daerah Pahang Timur at 25200 Kuantan.
Official JUPEM MyLot public viewer shell; its current configuration was retrieved and inspected.
Official JUPEM eBiz interactive product page describes digital cadastral lot products and login/purchase workflow.
Official PLANMalaysia i-Plan public viewer advertises a Lot Kadaster layer and search controls; no parcel response was retained for this city.

viewerConfiguration.observedTechnology: Current MyLot JavaScript configuration and public config JSON; REST-style JUPEM data service.
viewerConfiguration.schemaAndCrs: Config names parcel tables CSRS.RELATIVE_NDCDBLOT, CSRS.NDCDBLOT, and EGLMS.C3LOT; Pahang StateCode is 06 and StateProjection is EPSG:3379. No feature response was obtained to validate fields or geometry axis order.
viewerConfiguration.sourceFieldMapping: Observed only in public MyLot config QR-code column list; not used as a retained parcel identity because no parcel feature response was obtained.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier if independently verified

attempts.result: HTTP 200 public viewer shell retrieved; current script/configuration inspected.
HTTP 200; public configuration exposed Pahang host mapping, EPSG:3379, parcel table names, and MyLot route structure. No credential or token value was retained.
Timed out after 15 seconds; no response body.
HTTP 404; endpoint unavailable at the configured Pahang host.
HTTP 401 TokenNotFoundException; anonymous request rejected. No login or token-bearing request attempted.

geometryDecision: No full polygon retained; no qualifying safe anonymous parcel response was verified.

geometryEvidence.query: No parcel geometry query was submitted because the current official JUPEM data service required an unavailable authentication token and i-Plan service schema was not exposed by the bounded retrieval.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: JUPEM Pahang and Eastern Pahang District Survey Office custody plus official MyLot/eBiz/i-Plan channels.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No anonymous complete-polygon feature response verified.

remainingUncertainty: Exact MyLot parcel endpoint request syntax, native identity field, returned schema, anonymous access policy, and Kuantan coverage remain unverified. HTTP 401, timeout, 404, or a general viewer is not evidence of no cadastral records.

runtimeAssessment.reason: No independent anonymous ID-plus-geometry response; packet does not qualify an adapter or enable runtime.
